name: Camp Ramaquois
description_short: Day camp on 44 acres in Pomona next to Harriman State Park, with a 5 acre lake for boating and paddling, nine heated pools, sports fields, ropes and zip lines and crafts. Junior Camp takes ages 3 to 6, and separate girls' and boys' sides run from 2nd to 10th grade; door to door busing and a family style hot lunch are included.

sessions.name: Full session (8 weeks, no camp July 5)

notes: Families can also choose any 6 or 7 of the 8 weeks. The first session is marked limited availability. The Counselor Apprentice Program (entering 10th grade) is full session only. Tuition is not posted; the camp asks families to request it.
